title: nairim
description: A resource pack I have made (still working on it)
body:
_Nairim_:

Nairim is a small resource pack that I have made and will be working on,
and will be updating to change little things that I think would look better with a different texture

(**_phantoms_**, **_creepers_**, etc)

Currently the only thing I have changed is to make the allays texture to be purple.

I am unsure of when I will be adding to this due to an inconsistent schedule and this is just a side project
to have things all together so I don't have to manage many resource packs, and so I can easily share this with friends
plus the people that like the changes made.

Plans for ahead:
plans for ahead are quite unsure, its going to depend on things that I think would ~~when retextured~~ look great in game.
